# HTTP Content Negotiation & Versioning Strategies

API versioning and format negotiation: URL path versioning vs Accept header versioning, deprecation headers (Sunset RFC 8594), and gzip/brotli.

## Invariants
- SET_SUNSET_HEADER_ON_DEPRECATED_APIS
- STABLE_VERSIONING_ACROSS_MINOR_UPDATES
- SUPPORT_GZIP_AND_BROTLI_ENCODING
